story.summaryEn:
The people behind the FIA Karting World Cup! 👏🧡
This FIA Volunteers and Officials Month, we’re celebrating and thanking the incredible people who make motorsport possible 🏁
The FIA Karting Championship World Cup in Viterbo, Italy, brought together an army of dedicated volunteers and officials, all playing a vital role in ensuring the event ran safely and successfully 💪
#FIA #FIAVolunteersOfficialsMonth
detailZh:
FIA卡丁车世界杯背后的团队！👏🧡
在这个FIA志愿者和官员月，我们庆祝并感谢那些让赛车运动成为可能的人们 🏁
在意大利维特博举行的FIA卡丁车锦标赛世界杯，聚集了一支由专职志愿者和官员组成的队伍，他们在确保赛事安全顺利运行中发挥着至关重要的作用 💪
#FIA #FIAVolunteersOfficialsMonth

relatedItems.summaryEn:
Celebrating a major milestone in automotive technology! ⚡🏁
Congratulations to BYD and YANGWANG on the U9 Xtreme achieving a remarkable top speed of 503.17 km/h, becoming the first production car to surpass the 500 km/h barrier.
The FIA is proud to recognise this achievement, highlighting BYD’s continued innovation and contribution to shaping the future of road car technology 👏
#FIA #BYD #YANGWANG #SpeedRecognition
detailZh:
庆祝汽车技术重大里程碑！🏁
祝贺比亚迪和杨王汽车U9 Xtreme车型以503.17 km/h的惊人速度突破500 km/h大关，成为首款超过500 km/h的生产汽车。
The FIA为这一成就感到自豪，并强调比亚迪在塑造道路汽车技术未来方面的持续创新和贡献 👏
#FIA #BYD #YANGWANG #SpeedRecognition
